name: Shindou Kasumi
source:
Occupation: Nurse.
Room: Tsubomi Dorm, Room 301.
Characteristics: Kasumi is serious and hard-working, but sometimes she is an airhead. She is in charge of the health care of all dormitory students, and wants to make an injection to any person fallen ill. She has a weak body due to anemia, so she sometimes collapses and makes other worry about her.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
